ops.body:
Separate follow-up (Recommended)
Question: There's also an escape older than this branch (present at base, in R1 and in R2): in `rg --type-list -nC3 --files ~`, `--files` comes after a short-flag cluster the parser doesn't support (`-nC3`), so it's never read. `informational()` then skips the content rule and the listing guard never sees `--files`. Closing it means `informational()` must fail closed on an incomplete parse, which also affects grep, ugrep and git grep. What should I do with it?
Options: Separate follow-up (Recommended) | Fix rg only here | Fix all four here
